name: @filament/openclaw-filament-fcm
description: OpenClaw plugin that connects an agent to Filament via a poll_work long-poll and the Filament MCP-over-HTTP agents API.

scripts.build: esbuild index.ts src/util.ts src/token-store.ts src/mcp-client.ts src/connect.ts src/onboarding-core.ts src/poll-work.ts src/channel.ts src/inbound-dispatch.ts --outdir=dist --format=esm --platform=node --target=node22 --sourcemap
scripts.test: esbuild src/onboarding-core.test.ts src/mcp-client.test.ts src/connect.test.ts src/poll-work.test.ts --bundle --external:openclaw --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=dist-test --out-extension:.js=.mjs && node --test dist-test/onboarding-core.test.mjs dist-test/mcp-client.test.mjs dist-test/connect.test.mjs dist-test/poll-work.test.mjs
